goal: Implement parseCsv(text) and toCsv(rows) in src/csv.js to correctly parse and serialize CSV text, export both with CommonJS, and add tests in test/csv.test.js.

steps.title: Parse CSV rows and fields
steps.detail:
Implement parseCsv(text) in src/csv.js. Fields are separated by commas; rows end at a line feed or a carriage return plus line feed; a final line ending does not create an extra row; the empty text gives []. Examples: parseCsv('a,b
1,2
') is [['a','b'],['1','2']]; parseCsv('a

b') is [['a'],[''],['b']]; parseCsv('') is []; parseCsv('a,,c') is [['a','','c']]. Add or update focused tests in test/csv.test.js for row and field boundaries.

steps.title: Parse quoted CSV fields
steps.detail:
Implement quoted fields in parseCsv(text): a field may be wrapped in double quotes, and inside quotes commas, line feeds and carriage returns are ordinary characters and a doubled double quote is one double quote; a quoted empty field is an empty string. Examples: parseCsv('a,"b,c"
') is [['a','b,c']]; parseCsv('"say ""hi"""') is [['say "hi"']]; parseCsv('x,"line1
line2",y') is [['x','line1
line2','y']]. Add or update focused tests in test/csv.test.js for quoted fields.

steps.title: Reject malformed quoted fields
steps.detail: Implement parseCsv validation for malformed quotes: a quote that is never closed throws a SyntaxError whose message starts with 'Unterminated quote'; any character between a closing quote and the next comma or line ending throws a SyntaxError whose message starts with 'Unexpected character'. Examples: parseCsv('"abc') throws SyntaxError starting 'Unterminated quote'; parseCsv('"a"b,c') throws SyntaxError starting 'Unexpected character'. Add or update focused tests in test/csv.test.js for these errors.

steps.title: Preserve unquoted field content
steps.detail: Preserve non-delimiter characters in unquoted fields: spaces are kept exactly as written (no trimming); a double quote in the middle of an unquoted field is an ordinary character. Examples: parseCsv(' a , b ') is [[' a ',' b ']]; parseCsv('5" nail,x') is [['5" nail','x']]. Add or update focused tests in test/csv.test.js for these cases.

steps.title: Serialize CSV rows
steps.detail: Implement toCsv(rows). A field that contains a comma, a double quote, a line feed or a carriage return is wrapped in double quotes with inner double quotes doubled; other fields are written as they are; fields are joined by commas, rows by a line feed, and there is no line ending after the last row; toCsv([]) is the empty string. Examples: toCsv([['a','b,c'],['say "hi"','x']]) is 'a,"b,c"\n"say ""hi""",x'; parseCsv(toCsv(rows)) equals rows for rows [['a','b\nc'],['',',']]. Add or update focused tests in test/csv.test.js for serialization and round-tripping.

steps.title: Run the whole test suite
steps.detail: Run npm test. Change nothing unless it fails; fix only failures that this plan's change caused.
